jobs.title: Prototype Development for entrepreneurship project
jobs.description: A proposed project specification is being written and I hope to have it completed by end of next week.  In general, it would consist of a portal where the client would identify its industry, objectives, strengths, etc and the application (prototype) would develop a social media schedule, creative content, placement of the content and the reporting of results/KPIs.  We would want to demonstrate how the system continually improves (loops and graphs) strategy, content and performance.  As you know, a prototype just needs to demonstrate the basic idea without the bells and whistles required of a production-ready solution.
jobs.ai_reason: The job lacks a clear budget, offers no payment verification, has vague and overly broad requirements, and demands many disparate technologies. The timeline is unrealistic and competition is likely high, making it a risky proposition.
